8 انتضد , [quasi-pass. of 1, It was put, or set, one part upon, or beside, another, in regular order; was piled up, or became piled up]. (K, art. فقر.) ―
-b2- انتضد (tropical:) It (a people, A) remained, stayed, abode, or dwelt, in a place; (A, K;) and collected there. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
